coverage_audit.notes: The PDF text layer carries body text, figure captions and keyed figure notes, but dimension callouts inside the drawings are vector outlines and are absent from it. All 28 pages were therefore also rendered as images at roughly 200 dpi and read visually; figure-only dimensions are recorded as DIRECT_FIGURE evidence with a relocatable figure_dimension_label and with extraction_confidence medium or low. The pages listed in unreadable_or_ambiguous_pages are those where at least one callout was small, hand-lettered or ambiguous as to its endpoints; nothing was dropped on those pages - the affected items are kept as REFERENCE_ONLY with needs_verification true and listed in chapter_review_queue. Figure 4-30a on printed page 109 is hand-lettered throughout and its dimensions are the lowest-confidence content in this package.
